# Mozilla Public Suffix List (vendored)

`public_suffix_list.dat` is copied from [Public Suffix List](https://publicsuffix.org/list/)
and used at compile time via `include_str!` for cookie domain checks (F-058).

## Licence

https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ and the header comments inside `public_suffix_list.dat`.
